answer: Every epoch the network holds a liveness summit: each identity must sign a fresh unpredictable challenge with its device-entropy chip, whose seed was committed at registration, proving the chip is powered and online. One chip produces one onyx-black hardware fingerprint, so a single device can never emit two distinct pulses; copying the software yields identical outputs and exposes the duplicate. To field N sybils the attacker must buy and power N real chips and answer N simultaneous jetty-side challenges, one per physical dock, while an honest user simply taps a button once per epoch.
